purpose: Teach: 蠅/襪/繩/簑/襦/其/其の/舛

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、生物の授業で蠅、つまりハエの解剖したろ
lines.en: Riku — you dissected a fly in biology class, remember?
lines.style: Playful accusation, light and teasing. Quick rhythm. Leans forward slightly with a smirk. Drawing him into the game.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会の授業で昔の襪、つまり足袋習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned about foot wraps — old socks, basically — in history class, Sakura.
lines.style: Calm counter-volley. Almost bored delivery, but the eyes are sharp. Slight lift at the end, like he's returning serve perfectly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校で繩、つまり縄結びの練習してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were practicing rope knots at forest camp, weren't you.
lines.style: Knowing, relentless. Built-on momentum from before. Slight sing-song quality to catch him off-guard. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会の授業で簑、つまり昔の蓑見たろ、桜
lines.en: You saw those old rain capes in history class — what were they called again, Sakura.
lines.style: Deadpan. Deliberately slow. The confidence of someone who knows he's winning. Micro-pause before her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ばあちゃんが襦袢、つまり襦の話してたな
lines.en: Riku — your grandmother was talking about under-kimonos, wasn't she.
lines.style: Triumphant but controlled. Slight breathiness, like she's surprised herself with the catch. Quick rhythm now.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、古文で「其の場所」って読み方習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You memorized how to read 'that place' in classical Japanese class, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat, matter-of-fact. No inflection on the reading. The tone of someone laying down a winning card without fanfare.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、古文で「其、誠なり」って読まされたな
lines.en: Riku — you had to read that classical passage about 'truth' in class.
lines.style: Pushing past his defenses now. Quicker, sharper attacks. Slight rush of energy. Still playing, but pressing harder.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト用紙の名前と番号が舛違いだったろ、桜
lines.en: You mixed up your name and number on the test paper, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, cutting finisher. Slow, deliberate delivery with a wry smile underneath. One eyebrow raised. The killing blow, wrapped in sympathy.
